text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf, the "Emperor,"
has finally taken her first steps toward her Make Debut.

That news spread across the racing world
in the blink of an eyeâ

text_block_list.name: Male Passerby
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, did you see the news online?
Symboli Rudolf is finally...!"

text_block_list.name: Female Passerby
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! Word is she's super strong, right?
Haa~, I can't wait for her debut!

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
She's already being hailed as the 'Emperor,'
so claiming the Classic Triple Crown is practically guaranteed.

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how many more crowns will they add to that...?
This is gonna make huge waves!
We're definitely running the first special feature on it!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you look outside? There are so many reporters!
They're all after the President, aren't they.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
She's only just announced her debut, and yet...
As expected of the Student Council President!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: Totally, totally, she's so inspiring~. She's our pride and joy at the top, isn't she!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: If we follow the President, we can't go wrong!
Whether inside the academy or out, all anyone ever talked about were their high expectations for the "Emperor."

In a situation where anyone would feel the pressure,
as for the "Emperor" herself—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, everyone.
Full of vigor and vitality right from the start of the day, I see.
—She took it in stride, entirely calm and composed.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
P-President...!
Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry! We didn't mean
to gossip like that...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"No, pay it no mind.
What you just said suits my purposes quite well."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—If you feel that as long as you follow me,
you can't go wrong, then nothing could make me happier.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "I promise to forge straight ahead and never betray your trust."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to rely on me without hesitation from now on.
Understood?

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well now. Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer-kun.
Shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well then, once again... Trainer-kun.
Will you listen to me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"We shall now begin preparations for our debut.
However, naturally, that is not our final objective."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What I truly strive for—
is a world where every single Umamusume can live in happiness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Merely waiting impatiently, however,
will never create a new world.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Since ancient times, humanity has undergone constant trial and error
in their pursuit to create a better world.
The system born from that process is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Appointing an exceptional leader to guide the masses.
It is a system adopted across all eras and all nations up to this very day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If that is so, then resolving to guide the Umamusume
through this competitive world fraught with anguish and distress was...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —It is I, Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I am thoroughly inexperienced.
Blowing hot air would only sound like useless barking to others.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Which brings me to my point. My main objective right now
is to be an "Emperor" whose strength is beyond all doubt.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then, what evidence is there to prove it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A hint... Let's see.
Would "something worn upon the head" be too easy?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a crown.
It is clear, distinct, and majestic proof.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And speaking of the crown an Umamusume ought to wear—
naturally, it belongs only to the one who claims victory in the race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown,
consisting of the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—This is the bare minimum.
I absolutely must have these crowns, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And upon that, I vow to exert every ounce of my strength to seize victory and claim yet another crown.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And so, I ask you once more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Are you prepared to share my ambition
and make this grand, reckless dream a reality?

Her eyes gaze straight into mine.
It feels as though she's telling me
that half-baked resolve won't be accepted.

Her goal is set so extraordinarily high,
far too heavy for a single person to bear alone.

That is why I want to help pave the way for her.
Yes, ever since the day she chose me—
my resolve has long been set!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
Good answer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-kun.
I have high expectations of you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's put an end to all this stiff talk.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I called you here today for a simple reason.
I thought we might share a cup of coffee together."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Once you debut, we probably won't have many chances to chat leisurely like this, just the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we savor some aromatic coffee
while going over the finer details?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Just make sure you don't get too fired up
and "overheat."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Like... heat, coffee...
Yeah, okay, that was way too forced.

"...And so, the grand challenge
with Symboli Rudolf began!"
